description: Na₄Ni₃(PO₄)₂P₂O₇ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.92 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.85 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.68 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.52 Å. There are three inequivalent Ni sites. In the first Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.15 Å. In the second Ni site, Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.05-2.22 Å. In the third Ni site, Ni is bonded to five O atoms to form NiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four NiO₆ octahedra and corners with five PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 50-71°. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.10 Å. There are four inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-48°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.58 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NiO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 53-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.66 Å. In the third P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two NiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one NiO₅ square pyramid, and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-55°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.52-1.64 Å. In the fourth P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent NiO₅ square pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one NiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-46°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.53-1.58 Å. There are fifteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom to form distorted ONa₂NiP tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONaNi₂P tetrahedra and corners with four ONa₃P trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to three Na and one P atom to form distorted ONa₃P trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂NiP tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONa₃P trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaNi₂P trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom to form distorted ONaNi₂P tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂NiP tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONaNi₂P trigonal pyramids. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two P atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Ni, and one P atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ni, and one P atom.
